description: Every published product-classification dataset version, with the digest of the file that carries it. The digest is the SHA-256 of the file's bytes with CRLF normalised to LF - the bytes Git stores - so it is the same in a Windows working copy and in CI. A dataset version is immutable once an artifact has been trained against it: change the data and publish a new version with a new row here, never edit a row. tests/test_classification_dataset.py re-digests every file listed and refuses a mismatch, which is what makes a silent edit to a trained-against dataset a test failure rather than a quietly different meaning for every published number.

datasets.note: The seed set. 28 OCR texts and 5 model transcriptions from the 28 photographs of 10 retail packages in our-eval-v0.1-draft. Every label is model-drafted and unverified. Frozen: tfidf-logreg 0.1.0 records this digest in trained_on.dataset_sha256, and every figure in docs/ml/product-classification.md refers to these exact bytes.
